atoms.name: Memory chips and decoding
atoms.one_line: Chips = total bits over chip bits; high address bits drive the chip-select decoder.

atoms.name: Address split, direct mapped
atoms.one_line: Offset = log2 block size, index = log2 lines, tag is the rest; index plus offset = log2 cache size.

atoms.name: Set-associative and fully associative
atoms.one_line: Sets = lines over ways; each doubling of ways moves one bit from index to tag; fully associative has no index.

atoms.name: Tag directory size
atoms.one_line: Per line: tag + valid (+ dirty, replacement). Total = lines x entry bits.

atoms.name: AMAT, one level
atoms.one_line: AMAT = hit time + miss rate x penalty, or h x t_hit + (1-h) x t_miss when t_miss is the full time.

atoms.name: Multi-level AMAT
atoms.one_line: AMAT = t1 + m1 (t2 + m2 t_mem) with local miss rates; global rate = product.

atoms.name: CPI with memory stalls
atoms.one_line: CPI = base + references per instruction x miss rate x penalty; fetch counts as a reference.

atoms.name: Write policies
atoms.one_line: Write-through updates memory every write; write-back sets a dirty bit and writes on eviction; allocate vs no-allocate.

atoms.name: Replacement and miss types
atoms.one_line: LRU evicts the least recently used, FIFO the oldest loaded. Compulsory, capacity, conflict misses.

atoms.name: Block transfer and interleaving
atoms.one_line: Penalty = first word + (words - 1) x next-word time; banks deliver several words per round.

atoms.name: Locality and array traversal
atoms.one_line: Row-major scan: one miss per block; column scan with a power-of-two stride can thrash a few sets.

atoms.name: DRAM refresh overhead
atoms.one_line: Overhead = rows x row-refresh time over period; chips refresh in parallel.
